name: MACD divergence at a liquidity sweep (London + NY open)

params.costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries, stop and market exits
params.data: CME NQ1! 5m (TradingView), 1m for the 2026 trade path

rules: Chart: NQ 5-minute, CME futures. Trade only 02:00-05:00 ET (London) and 09:30-11:00 ET (New York open); 1 trade a day.

Liquidity: any LIT level of the day (Asia / London / NY session highs and lows, premarket box, previous day / week / month high and low, NWOG / NDOG gaps, build-ups = equal highs / lows). Wait for the first time today that price trades through one of them.
Depth: the sweep must reach at least 0.5 x ATR(14, 5m) beyond the level.

Confirmation (CISD): within 2 hours of the sweep a 5m candle closes back through the open of the run of candles that made the sweep extreme (for a short: closes below the open of the last up-candle run into the high).

MACD divergence (12/26/9, MACD line, 5m): at that close the MACD line at the sweep-extreme bar is weaker than at the highest prior swing high of the last 4 hours (lowest swing low for a long) while price made a higher high (lower low).
Entry: market at the next 5m open. Stop: 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Target: the 18:00 ET open +/- 1 VIX one-day move (VIX/100/sqrt(252) x price), at least 1.5R away (else no trade), banked at 8R. No breakeven.
15-minute check (as LIT): 15 minutes after the fill, if the trade never reached +0.5R and is more than 0.3R under water, exit at market.
Flat at 15:55 ET. Size: $500 risk a trade = 500 / (stop pts x $2) micros, max 40 (eval: also capped at 0.6 x room to the trailing max loss / (stop x $2)).
